lead: An `[[app]]` block in the root `nvs.toml` whose `entry` names a file that is not on disk breaks every program in the tree, not only that one.
body: The whole configuration is resolved before anything runs, so a grant written for a proof program that does not exist yet answers `E0605: cannot read …` for whatever example you were actually running. A `--bless` of three examples then reports three failures whose message names a file you have not written. Write the `.nvs` files first and the `[[app]]` blocks after them, and let the grants ride in the commit that adds the last program they name.
